first_storyboard.title: Understanding Your CRT‑D

scenes.narration: If you need a pacemaker and defibrillator, doctors may recommend a CRT‑D. They will discuss risks and benefits. Check-ups occur every 3‑6 months. If heart failure worsens despite medicines, an upgrade may be considered.
scenes.visual_description: Doctor showing a small heart device model to patient.
